meta.title: SkelApp POS — Point of Sale System in Tanzania | Works Offline
meta.description: SkelApp is the offline-first POS system built for Tanzania. Ring up sales in seconds, record every payment however it's made, and track stock and madeni automatically. From TZS 500 a day.

feature_groups.title: Cashflow that stays close to every sale.
feature_groups.body: Use the same SkelApp on iOS, Android and web, across one shop or many locations, with every money movement recorded in one live system.
feature_groups.items_text:
Multi-device | Owners, attendants and managers can all work from the device that fits them best while staying inside one synced SkelApp account. | assets/card.webp
Multi-location | Run one branch or many, then split sales, stock and staff activity by location without losing the full business view. | assets/CHECKOUTPOS.png
Sales ledger | Every shilling in and out is captured the moment it happens, so the day never needs rebuilding from memory. | assets/CASHFLOW.png
Profit view | Open the dashboard and understand what sold, what moved out and where the money stands right now. | assets/DASHBOARD.png
Debts & credits | Track both sides of the relationship, from customer balances to supplier credits and the payment accounts that keep them organised. | assets/crm.webp
Payment accounts | Split cash, bank, card and mobile money into the right accounts so reconciliation is clean at closing time. | assets/paymentmethod.png

feature_groups.title: Inventory that keeps the whole shop in sync.
feature_groups.body: Move beyond simple stock counts with location-aware controls, batch tracking and the daily signals that tell you what needs attention next.
feature_groups.items_text:
Advanced stock | Keep day-to-day stock handling inside one workflow instead of spreading it across notebooks, spreadsheets and memory. | assets/STOCKLIST.png
Batch tracking | Track stock by batch so you know what came in, what sold first and what needs acting on next. | assets/hardware.webp
Transfers | Move items from one branch to another with a clear record of where stock left, where it landed and who handled it. | assets/grocery.webp
Adjustments | Correct counts, process returns and keep the stock ledger accurate without hiding what changed. | assets/kitchenware.webp
Stock analysis | Stock analysis helps you spot the products that are moving fastest, running low or nearing expiry before they become a problem. | assets/autospare.webp
Returns | Handle customer and supplier returns without breaking stock accuracy or losing the paper trail behind each change. | assets/Pos System 04.png

feature_groups.title: Reports, online orders and your wider retail stack.
feature_groups.body: Run the back office from one place, launch online ordering quickly and connect the finance and messaging tools your business already uses.
feature_groups.items_text:
Online orders | Turn your live stock list into a simple online store, share the link and let customer orders land straight inside SkelApp. | assets/Mobilehomeview.png
Integrations | Connect Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, bulk SMS providers and WhatsApp so records and customer updates stay in sync. | assets/quickbooks.png
Reports | Review P&L, cashflow, sales by item, customer and attendant, plus stock and expense reports without waiting for manual summaries. | assets/DASHBOARD.png
Attendants | Give every attendant their own login, control access and see who sold what, when and from which location. | assets/attendants.webp
P&L | See profit and loss without rebuilding the numbers manually at the end of the day or month. | assets/DASHBOARD.png
Sales insights | Break sales down by item, customer, attendant or branch so the next decision is based on real numbers. | assets/CASHFLOW.png

offline.title: Keep selling when the power or network drops
offline.subtitle: SkelApp is an offline-first POS. Here's what happens in a blackout:

steps.body: Offline mode switches on by itself the moment power or internet goes down. No button, no panic.
Sales, payments and receipts keep working right on the device — your queue never notices.

items.a: SkelApp is a point of sale system built for small businesses in Tanzania. It runs on your phone, a tablet, or the Skel Register, and handles checkout, payments, stock, madeni and daily reports in one app.
Yes — SkelApp is an offline-first POS. When power or network drops, you keep selling on the device, and everything syncs the moment you're back online.
Cash, mobile money, bank transfers and cards — record every payment however your customers pay, with payment accounts keeping each method reconciled.

items.q: Do I need to buy hardware?
items.a: No. SkelApp starts on the phone already in your pocket. Add a receipt printer or the Skel Register whenever your counter is ready for one.
TZS 15,000 per month — about 500 shillings a day — or TZS 150,000 per year with two months free. Every feature included, no tiers.

items.q: Can I run more than one shop?
items.a: Yes. Every branch and staff account is included — you see every location's sales, stock and staff activity from one dashboard, and you can transfer stock between locations.

items.q: Which devices does SkelApp run on?
items.a: iOS, Android and any web browser — phone, tablet, computer or the Skel Register, all synced to the same account.

items.q: Does SkelApp work with accounting software?
items.a: Yes — SkelApp integrates with Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero and Sage, plus bulk SMS providers and WhatsApp for receipts and customer messages.
